description:
We're BlueCat—a Great Place to Work for good reason. Our team solves critical network challenges for some of the world's largest organizations. In simple terms, we manage the systems that keep networks running smoothly, securely, and reliably—the backbone infrastructure that powers digital transformation for enterprises globally. Our Intelligent Network Operations platform delivers and enables AI-driven agentic ops at scale, automating and simplifying how companies manage, secure, and optimize their networks.

But what makes us different is how we work: we believe great work happens in an environment where you're trusted, heard, and supported. With teams globally, we're building a workplace culture that values collaboration and integrity as much as innovation. If you're looking to advance your career with a company that invests in its people, this is it.

 

BlueCat's Americas sales organization exists to build predictable, scalable growth across DDI and network observability. We are seeking an experienced Regional Vice President of Enterprise Sales to lead our eastern region of North America. You will lead six to ten enterprise Account Executives selling the full BlueCat portfolio into large, strategic accounts (generally companies with more than 5,000 employees), with a focus on Enterprise DDI. You will own regional strategy and execution, coach and develop your sellers, and partner with senior leadership to align regional efforts with BlueCat's broader strategy. You will report to BlueCat's Senior Vice President, Sales, Americas. Final territory alignment will be determined in part by the successful candidate's location.

Responsibilities

  • Revenue ownership: Deliver the region's New ARR targets annually and quarterly, and forecast accurately, flagging risk early with options to still reach the number.
  • Regional strategy: Build and execute a regional plan for targeting, resource allocation and sales tactics that drives new logos, existing-customer expansion, DDI and network observability cross-sell, and adoption of new products.
  • Team leadership: Coach Account Executives through measurable behaviors: pipeline creation, sales process discipline, deal inspection and consistent follow-up.
  • Talent: Own recruiting, hiring, onboarding and performance management for your team, using BlueCat's structured, evidence-based hiring process, and build a high-accountability culture.
  • Inspection and execution: Maintain healthy pipeline coverage, run a disciplined weekly forecast cadence, and lead documented deal reviews on strategic opportunities covering business drivers, competition, executive sponsorship, buying process, risks, close plan and probability to close.
  • High-value deals: Personally engage on and close the region's largest, most complex deals, structuring and negotiating terms and pricing in coordination with senior leadership.
  • Strategic accounts: Own relationships with the region's key accounts, building C-level relationships and driving adoption, retention and growth.
  • Cross-functional partnership: Partner with Sales Engineering, Customer Success, Business Development, Channel and Marketing to win and expand accounts.
  • Reporting: Run quarterly business reviews and team performance reviews.

Knowledge, Skills and Experience Required

  • Proven track record leading enterprise software sales teams, ideally six to ten quota-carrying sellers, and consistently exceeding New ARR targets.
  • Experience leading complex, solution-based sales into large enterprise and Fortune 2000-level accounts.
  • Demonstrated ability to hire, assess and develop top-tier sellers using a structured, evidence-based approach.
  • Working knowledge of networking, cloud, observability and cybersecurity markets; DDI or infrastructure software experience is a plus.

What We Look For

  • Executive presence: Builds credible relationships at the C-level, internally and externally.
  • Sales process discipline: Inspects pipeline and deals rigorously, makes decisions on data and evidence rather than optimism, and forecasts with integrity.
  • Business acumen: Connects customer business drivers to BlueCat solutions, and negotiates for long-term value.
  • Talent and coaching: Accurately assesses talent, and develops sellers through specific, measurable feedback.
  • Collaboration: Shares context, involves the right partners early, and puts shared outcomes ahead of individual credit.
  • Curiosity and ownership: Asks why, takes accountability, and stays resilient under quota pressure.
  • Travel: Able to travel frequently throughout North America, and occasionally internationally.

 

What Success Looks Like (First 12–24 Months)

  • Deliver New ARR at or above the region's plan, annually and quarterly.
  • Forecast accurately and consistently, with risks flagged early alongside alternative paths to the number.
  • Maintain healthy pipeline coverage and a strong pipeline-creation rate going into each quarter.
  • Build a fully staffed, ramped team of high-performing Account Executives, hired against defined role criteria and meeting ramp-time targets.
  • Grow new-logo wins and DDI/network observability cross-sell in the region year over year.
  • Close the region's largest strategic deals, with documented deal reviews on every strategic opportunity.
  • Retain and grow key enterprise accounts through C-level relationships.

 

This opportunity is open to candidates across the United States within a one-hour drive of a major airport.

 

This position offers a salary range of $370,000 - $460,000 USD this is made up from base plus commission. Final compensation will be determined based on skills, experience, and qualifications. 

If you share our enthusiasm for the future of our company and are eager to contribute to our vibrant workplace, we look forward to receiving your application!
 
This position is eligible for a comprehensive benefits package, including medical, dental, and vision insurance; tax advantaged accounts (HSA, FSA); annual Lifestyle Spending Account (LSA); a 401(k) with company matching; paid parental leave; vacation, personal, and wellness days; an annual learning and development budget. Eligible employees may also participate in the company's annual bonus program.
 
Join us in shaping the future of our organization, where your talent and dedication can truly thrive. We invite you to apply and become a valuable member of our team!
 
BlueCat is an Equal Opportunity Employer that is committed to inclusion and diversity. We also take affirmative action to offer employment and advancement opportunities to all applicants, including minorities, women, protected veterans, and individuals with disabilities. BlueCat will not discriminate or retaliate against applicants who inquire about, disclose, or discuss their compensation or that of other applicants. 
 
BlueCat participates in the E-Verify program to confirm the employment eligibility of new hires based in the USA. The E-Verify process is completed in conjunction with the Form I-9 Employment Eligibility Verification on or before the first day of work. E-Verify is not used as a tool to pre-screen candidates. For more information about E-Verify, please visit https://www.e-verify.gov/employees.
